title: Engine-extraction review: living-world-rogue
summary: Code review of the living-world-rogue repo judging which subsystems to extract into the new engine, covering coupling, extension points, performance, quality and ranked recommendations.
notes: Evidence document: a review of a predecessor codebase with per-subsystem verdicts (EXTRACT-AS-IS / EXTRACT-WITH-REDESIGN / GAME-SIDE / DROP) and a ranked recommendations section (F). It is not an ADR (no status or decision record; the decisions it informs are locked in docs/PLAN.md), not a PRD (no user stories or acceptance criteria), not a SPEC (tables are inventories and benchmarks, not contracts). Synthesizer should treat recommendations as context/rationale cited by PLAN.md, not as requirements.
